worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 25,750.00 + long-term gains 30,000.00 = 55,750.00. Federal taxable income = 55,750.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 40,000.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; line 24 subtractions 0.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 55,750.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 15,750.00; line 3 40,000.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 40,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 40,000.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 40,000.00; line 2 net long-term gains 30,000.00; line 3 lesser 30,000.00; line 4 ordinary income 40,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 10,000.00; line 5 21,100.00; line 6 21,100.00 - 10,000.00 = 11,100.00; line 7 lesser of lines 3 and 6 = 11,100.00; line 8 3% x 11,100.00 = 333.00; line 9 30,000.00 - 11,100.00 = 18,900.00; line 10 4.1% x 18,900.00 = 774.90; line 11 333.00 + 774.90 = 1,107.90; line 12 ordinary income tax on 10,000.00: 4.7% x 10,000.00 = 470.00; line 13 1,107.90 + 470.00 = 1,577.90, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 21,100.00 = 991.70; 5.9% x (40,000.00 - 21,100.00 = 18,900.00) = 1,115.10; bracket tax 2,106.80. Gains limited to taxable income: lesser of 30,000.00 and 40,000.00 = 30,000.00; extra rate -1.8% x 30,000.00 = -540.00; 2,106.80 - 540.00 = 1,566.80. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 1,566.80. The form gives 1,577.90; expected keeps the projection's 1,566.80, a difference of 11.10 from 3% against 2.9% on the 11,100.00 of gains inside the first bracket, 11.10. This is the projection's own example: booklet 1,577.90, projection 1,566.80.
accepted_approximations: Montana taxes long-term gains at two rates, and the format holds one extra rate. Gains run through the ordinary brackets on top of ordinary income and pay an extra rate of -0.018 (4.1% less 5.9%). That is exact for gains above the first bracket, and gives 2.9% where the booklet says 3% for gains inside it. The gains must be limited to taxable income first (Form 2 page 2 line 3).
